name: Swim
description: The first clip turns into a fish and swims out of the frame head first: its body narrows into a forked tail, a bending wave runs from its head to its tail and swings wider beat by beat, lighting and shading its flanks as it bends and driving it faster until it is gone, revealing the second clip under its soft shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: swing
params.description: How far the tail swings, as a part of the frame's short side

params.name: taper
params.description: How much the body narrows toward the tail

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the shading on the bends and of the shadow
